query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

message.content:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

**Farewell, Stephen! 🚀**

They say you don't know what you've got till it's gone—well, we're about to find out what happens when we lose the guy who could debug production *and* drop the perfect meme at 9:47 AM on a Monday. Spoiler: we're doomed.

Stephen, you weren't just one of our best engineers—you were the architect of our group chat's entire personality. Your code was clean, your memes were immaculate, and your ability to do both simultaneously was frankly suspicious. We're pretty sure you had a secret clone.

As you ship off to your next adventure, remember: every `git push` you make, we'll be watching. Every meme you post, we'll be stealing. And every time your new team laughs at something you built, just know—we taught you everything*.

*Except the memes. Those were pure, unhinged Stephen.

Go build amazing things. And please—*please*—don't let your new team's Slack be a desert.

We'll miss you, legend. 💻✨

**#StephenSzn #GoneButNeverForgotten #PleaseAcceptOurLinkedInRequests**

---

*P.S. — We finally figured out your "I'll fix it in 5 minutes" was actually 47 minutes. Still impressive. Still love you.*

---
